judge_response:
ANALYSIS: Malignant catatonia and neuroleptic malignant syndrome have overlapping features (hyperthermia, autonomic instability, rigidity) but are distinct clinical entities with different typical etiologies and treatments (NMS from dopamine‑blocking agents with management including withdrawal of offending agent, supportive care, dantrolene/bromocriptine; malignant catatonia responds to benzodiazepines/ECT). They are not clinically equivalent.

VERDICT: INCORRECT
